text:
The pre-send EIN check refuses a **business-return export when the same firm has already sent documents for that EIN under a different client**.

The local helper chain is:

- [`perform`](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:53) calls `prepare_params`, then `validate_ein_already_sent!`, before document validation or sending.
- [`prepare_params`](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:137) determines whether the return is a business return and retains the EIN only for business returns.
- [`already_sent_bound_account_id`](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:116) skips personal returns. Otherwise, it finds tax preparations with the **same `firm_id` and EIN**, excludes the current `client_id`, and requires a related `TaxAutomations::Document` record. It chooses the matching preparation with the highest ID and returns its client ID.
- [`validate_ein_already_sent!`](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:111) raises `BoundAccountError` when that ID is present. [`already_sent_error`](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:128) builds the unprocessable/422 error with `bound_account_id`; `perform` rescues it into a failure.

The lookup has **no tax-year, return-type, provider, or document-status filter**. Another firm’s filing, the current client’s filing, or a preparation without a document record does not trigger this refusal.
